object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time activation attempted for ${entitlementName} on behalf of ${requestedForIdentityName} failed.

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies a manager, requester, or other interested party that a Just-In-Time activation attempted on behalf of another identity did not succeed.
object.id: [Default] Just-In-Time Activation Failed for Requested-For Identity
object.name: Just-In-Time Activation Failed for Requested-For Identity
object.subject: Just-In-Time Activation Failed for ${requestedForIdentityName}
